Description: Provides the Banhmi operator IAM user with AWS AdministratorAccess, no permissions boundary, and no expiry. Creates no console password or access key.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: IAM user -> AWS managed AdministratorAccess policy for AWS CLI and AWS MCP operations
must: No console password or access key in this stack
Preserve the OperatorUser logical ID and UserName to keep the existing user and access key
No permissions boundary or expiry; repository rules govern operator actions

UserName.Description: IAM user name for the Banhmi administrator operator. The stack does not create a password or access key.
UserName.ConstraintDescription: must contain only IAM user-name characters

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Provides a separate non-console administrator principal for Banhmi AWS CLI and AWS MCP operations; credentials remain outside CloudFormation and the repository in an owner-only env file.
must: Keep logical ID OperatorUser and UserName unchanged during updates
Attach AWS managed AdministratorAccess without a permissions boundary or expiry
